svg.title: The larger steps of the blueprint
svg.desc: 0.1 to 0.8 brought seven kinds of projects, the settings as code, the release bot, the websites and SLSA Build Level 3; 0.9 to 0.13 the Rollout of every release, the PR coach and the blueprint for any owner; 1.0 made it stable, with a policy of versions; 1.1 to 1.5 brought the Chrome extension, the settings app and one list of the repositories; 1.6 to 1.9 titles and lock files that fix themselves, several further languages and the accessibility check at the width of a phone; 1.10 to 1.13 the Cloudflare Worker, /fix on forks and container images at SLSA Build Level 3; 1.14 to 1.17 a social preview that draws the kind of project, the steps Binary files and Records of decisions, and a refresh of the lock files that merges by itself. Next come the pictures of a visual change in the report of a pull request, commands in pull requests, more kinds of projects and a website that shows the blueprint.
